dossier.summary: Brightwave Logistics runs regional freight across the Midwest with 420 people and a headquarters in Chicago. One operations team handles dispatch, billing and customer updates for every terminal.
dossier.why_now: Opened two new cross-dock sites this year.

data.title: Growing volume, not headcount
data.subtitle: How operations teams at mid-size logistics and manufacturing companies take on more freight with the same people. Two talks, then your questions.

data.why_you: This session was planned with companies like Brightwave in mind: 420 people, two new cross-dock sites this year, and an operations team that did not grow with them. The second talk is from a carrier a year further down that road.
